test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

His performace in the play was outstanding.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'performace'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'performance'.**
 
• The word '**performance**' is a **noun** which means 'the action or process of performing a task or function'. **(प्रदर्शन)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• His performance in the play was outstanding.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'performace'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Play -** a dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage **(नाटक)**
 
• **Outstanding - **exceptionally good **(उत्कृष्ट)**
 
• **His -** possessive form of he **(उसका)**
